answer: Bond is 500 POA per identity, reward capped at 2,000 POA per identity per epoch, so a farm of 1,000 locks 500,000 POA for a ceiling of 2,000,000 and only if every task passes. A verified task pays 12 POA; a fake costs 500 locked plus a review. After three idle epochs the bond is worth more than the account, so the karst under the ledge is thin. Sable math: the bond is the only number that never pays to lose.
